drivingQuestion: Why may he not enter the field if the land is ownerless in the Sabbatical Year?

segments.he: אָמַר עוּלָּא: בְּעוֹמְדִין אִילָנוֹת עַל הַגְּבוּלִים. רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן אֶלְיָקִים אָמַר: גְּזֵירָה שֶׁמָּא יִשְׁהֶא בַּעֲמִידָה.
segments.en: «Ulla said:» The mishna is referring to a case «where» the fruit «trees are standing on the borders» of the field. Since it is possible to eat the produce without entering the field, it is not permitted for him to enter it. «Rabbi Shimon ben Elyakim said:» Even in a case where the fruit trees are standing in the middle of the field, it is also prohibited for him to enter the field, due to a rabbinic «decree lest he remain standing» there longer than necessary for purposes of eating, which is prohibited even during the Sabbatical Year.
